conditions.meaning: Reports whether the selected graph snapshot and workspace access checks allow input binding.
Reports whether the controller recorded the exact source identities in status.sourceBindings.
Reports progress selecting inputs, running trials, and publishing the winning model. Read it with status.phase.

example.introduction: The study is running trials for the planned candidates and seeds.
example.nextCheck: Compare status.plannedTrials with status.trials. Follow each child TrainingRun to inspect its progress.
example.title: Trials are running

narrative: For a trial waiting on scheduling, follow its TrainingRun in `status.trials` and read the child’s `status.failure`. The study copies `spec.template.placementTemplateRef` and `spec.template.materializationPlacementTemplateRef` to each new trial.
